description: src/lib.rs:339 — build_path bypasses CertPool's public IntoIterator API with pool.certs.as_slice() accessing the private field directly. This creates internal coupling: if the field is renamed or the storage representation changes, build_path silently breaks. Replace with a dedicated CertPool::as_slice() method (or use the existing iter() method and collect, though passing a slice to dfs is preferable for performance). The field certs is not pub, so this only works because build_path is in the same module — but the design intent of CertPool as an opaque type is violated.
title: [rusty/pkix-path-builder] build_path accesses pool.certs directly
